limitations: No new native CI, native browser HTTP/CSP/session storage/download or production acceptance.
Detectors are bounded structural checks, not general causal, semantic or predictive intelligence.
Prompts are a documented process/future provider specification; current detectors call no model.
Independent fixer usefulness, source-to-plan model quality and secure agency gates remain open.
Snapshot and insight hash chains are local application records, not independent anchoring or administrator-proof evidence custody.
